title: Making a Phone Call
context: Phone English is its own little language: answering, asking for someone, bad connections, taking messages, ending politely.
contextPersian: انگلیسیِ تلفن زبان کوچک خودش را دارد: جواب دادن، کسی را خواستن، آنتن بد، پیغام گرفتن، تمام کردن مودبانه.

expressions.example: I'll give you a call tomorrow morning.
expressions.note: Natural alternative to 'call someone'. Also: give me a ring (BrE).

expressions.example: — Can I speak to Sara? — Who's calling, please?
expressions.examplePersian: — می‌توانم با سارا صحبت کنم؟ — شما؟

expressions.example: — Could I speak to Mr. Karimi? — Speaking.
expressions.examplePersian: — می‌توانم با آقای کریمی صحبت کنم؟ — خودم هستم.
expressions.note: The one-word answer when the caller asks for you.

expressions.example: Hold on a moment, I'll get her for you.
I'll put you through to the support team.
expressions.examplePersian: شما را به تیم پشتیبانی وصل می‌کنم.

expressions.example: He's not in right now — would you like to leave a message?
Could you ask her to call me back when she's free?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود بگویید وقتی آزاد شد با من تماس بگیرد؟

expressions.example: Sorry, you're breaking up — can you say that again?
expressions.examplePersian: ببخشید، صدات قطع‌ووصل می‌شود — دوباره می‌گویی؟

expressions.english: I'll hang up and try again
expressions.example: The line's bad — I'll hang up and try again.
expressions.examplePersian: خط خراب است — قطع می‌کنم و دوباره می‌گیرم.
ممنون که زنگ زدی — به زودی صحبت می‌کنیم!

acceptedAnswers: Could you ask him to call me back?

speakingTask.instruction: Practice a short call out loud: answer, say the person isn't available, offer to take a message.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: یک تماس کوتاه را بلند تمرین کن: جواب بده، بگو طرف نیست، پیشنهاد پیغام گرفتن بده.
modelSentences: Hold on a moment, I'll check if she's in.
I'm sorry, she's not available right now.
Would you like to leave a message, or shall I ask her to call you back?

roleplay.aiRole: A receptionist at a company the learner is calling
roleplay.learnerRole: You're calling to speak to Ms. Rahimi about an invoice
roleplay.objective: Get through or leave a proper message with your details
roleplay.context: Ms. Rahimi is out. The learner must ask for her, understand she's unavailable, leave a clear message with name and callback number, and end politely. At one point the connection gets bad.
roleplay.opening: Good morning, Pars Trading, how can I help you?
